name: Child Rearing
overview: Scripture teaches that children are a precious heritage from the Lord, entrusted to parents as a divine reward and responsibility. Effective child rearing involves heartfelt instruction and discipline, as seen in the command to keep God's words in one's heart and to train children in the way they should go so they will not depart from it. Loving correction through timely chastening is emphasized to remove foolishness from a child's heart, underscoring the necessity of firm but loving guidance. Furthermore, honoring and respecting parents is mandated with serious consequences for disobedience, highlighting the sacredness of family relationships.
